name: Lab setup
goal: Stand up a lab that can qualify 1.6T DR8 OSFP optics on TH6 switches.

name: DR8 optics sourcing
goal: Pick the 1.6T DR8 source(s), LRO and/or FRO, with samples in the lab.

name: Switch vendor selection
goal: Primary: Arista 7060XE7-64PRS-RV3-L. Backup for lead-time risk: Nexthop NH-4220-F. Plus a lab test switch.

name: Qualification
goal: Run the optic × switch qualification matrix to a pass/fail decision.

name: Test data analysis
goal: Repeatable analysis and reports for every qual run.

name: 1.6T DR8 simulation
goal: dr8sim: end-to-end 1.6T DR8 link model (host Condor SerDes → optics → host), backing the LRO vs FRO choice.
